headline: Dual language school model, reuse of 617 Lexington Street, FY '27 budget transfers, and the 617 Transformer Project, plus collective bargaining strategy sessions.
summary: The meeting covers the Dual Language School model and the use of 617 Lexington Street. It also includes school improvement plans, budget transfer requests, the 617 Transformer Project, and executive sessions on collective bargaining with five employee groups.
